body:
### Problem

With `foldexpr=v:lua.vim.treesitter.foldexpr()`, a fold that starts above the edited lines and becomes foldable because of the edit never gets created. I hit it in Markdown. A note has only `# Title`, I type a blank line and some text under it, and the heading still has no fold. `foldlevel(1)` stays `0` and `zc` on it gives `E490: No fold found`. The wrong level carries down too: a `## Section` typed later gets level 1 instead of 2.

`zx` does not fix it. `:e` or `:setlocal foldminlines=1` does, since both trigger a full recompute.

The cause seems to be in `runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/_fold.lua`. After an edit, `on_bytes` ([L376-L377](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/v0.12.6/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/_fold.lua#L376-L377)) and `on_changedtree` ([L306-L307](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/v0.12.6/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/_fold.lua#L306-L307)) recompute from `srow - foldminlines`. `compute_folds_levels()` takes the base level from the cache ([L145](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/v0.12.6/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/_fold.lua#L145)) and writes `>N` only from `srow + 1` ([L149](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/v0.12.6/runtime/lua/vim/treesitter/_fold.lua#L149)). Line 1 is outside that range, so it keeps `0`. Setting `srow = 0` in both places makes the fold appear. Master (9b7ec59) has the same logic.

Probably not the same as #38356, #28692 or #32759. Those are about the initial compute or folds getting closed, while here the folds are right on open and go wrong after an edit.

### Steps to reproduce

```sh
printf '# Title\n' > t.md
nvim --clean --cmd 'set foldmethod=expr foldexpr=v:lua.vim.treesitter.foldexpr() foldlevel=99' t.md
```

Type one key at a time, do not paste:

1. `o<CR>foo<CR>bar<Esc>`
2. `:echo foldlevel(1)` prints `0`
3. `ggzc` gives `E490: No fold found`
4. `:w`, `:e`, then `:echo foldlevel(1)` prints `1` and `ggzc` closes lines 1-4

### Expected behavior

After step 1, line 1 starts a fold over lines 1-4, same as after `:e` in step 4.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.12.6, Build type: Release, LuaJIT 2.1.1791988261
Also reproduces on nightly NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1868+gbe5167e21c.

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A, this is `vim.treesitter.foldexpr()`

### Operating system/version

macOS 15.5 (24F74), arm64

### Terminal name/version

Ghostty 1.3.1. The steps above also reproduce in tmux 3.8.

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-ghostty (tmux-256color inside tmux)

### Installation

Homebrew
